title: Stoked
meta_description: Stoked: 3BR beach house in Grayton with Gulf views, 2 decks, swing bed \& 2 living rooms. Walk to Red Bar \& beach. Sleeps 6.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THIS HOME: Are you STOKED about your next beach trip? If not, you're about to be! Stoked is the ultimate beach house getaway with the feel of old 30A with all of the modern conveniences of a luxury beach house - including a complimentary 6-seater LIV golf cart for your stay! Nestled among the sand dunes, you have amazing GULF VIEWS from either of the two spacious decks and both living rooms! Plus, there's a balcony bed-swing for naps in the shade and sunset views of the Gulf! One visit and you'll make us your lifetime vacation tradition!

ABOUT THE AREA: The best of both worlds: be on the Gulf, walkable to the famous Red Bar (wait for the buzzer while relaxing on the covered porch) or Western Lake for paddle boarding. And if shopping is your thing, you have plenty in Grayton Beach, Seaside and Watercolor as well as farmers markets in both Watercolor and Seaside.

BEACH ACCESS: Grayton Dunes is the beach access closest to home! When you get to the end of your road, take a left and the gorgeous turquoise water is directly ahead! Grayton Beach State Park is one of the most beautiful parks in the area. If you want access to winding trails amongst the massive dunes, strolling along a coastal dune lake as well as a stunning beach with all the facilities, then this is a perfect option.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - 1 King
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 Queen
• Bedroom 3 -- 1 Queen

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Complimentary 6-seater LIV Golf cart
• 2 Adult Bikes
• 2 Living Rooms
• 2 Covered Porches
• Full bed swing on porch
• Outdoor Shower
• Propane Grill
• Smart TVs in all rooms
• Coffee Maker -- traditional drip
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2-3 parking spaces with no overflow parking.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
